changes: Added experimental cloud vault sync: after a successful Territorial.io login, the account is added to the local vault and uploaded to a Cloudflare Worker/D1 using a local 64-hex sync ID.
Sync uses AES-256-GCM with a fixed client key and stores only the encrypted blob; the sync ID is the capability secret. Treat this as obfuscation, not zero-knowledge.
Territorial.io 2.16.67 support; shipping tools; lobby chat Unicode button; Tools card menu.
